name: Animals & Pet Supplies
subcats: Dog Food, Cat Food, Pet Toys, Pet Health, Aquarium Supplies, Small Animal Supplies
shopping: Feed quality and freshness claims must comply with AAFCO standards in product listings
Amazon dominates branded pet food search — differentiation requires niche positioning
Subscription models (Chewy, BarkBox) have trained consumers to expect auto-ship discounts
Product images must show actual product, not lifestyle imagery, for Shopping compliance
Weight-based shipping for heavy items (litter, large food bags) erodes margins on low-AOV orders
social: Pet content performs exceptionally on social — 2-3x engagement rates vs other ecommerce verticals
User-generated pet photos drive the highest engagement but require content rights management
Influencer partnerships with pet accounts reach highly targeted audiences at lower CPMs
Facebook's pet owner targeting combines purchase behavior and interest signals effectively
Video ads showing pets interacting with products outperform static images by 40-60%
seo: Breed-specific and species-specific long-tail keywords have lower competition and higher conversion
Health and nutrition content builds E-E-A-T for pet supplies — veterinary partnerships add authority
Product reviews and comparison content capture mid-funnel search intent effectively
Local pet store SEO competes directly with Chewy and Amazon — emphasize same-day and local pickup
Seasonal pet content (holiday safety, summer care) captures informational intent year-round
landing: Pet size and breed selectors on landing pages personalize the shopping experience
Subscription options on product pages increase LTV by 60-80% for consumable products
Auto-ship discount messaging on first-purchase pages drives initial subscription signups
Trust badges from veterinary organizations and safety certifications increase conversion 15-25%
Free shipping thresholds should be set at 1.3x average order value to encourage upsells
smallbiz: Niche specialization (reptiles, raw pet food, organic treats) avoids direct Amazon competition
Local pet stores can leverage community events and in-store experiences online competitors can't match
Subscription boxes with curated products create predictable revenue and reduce CAC over time
Partnering with local shelters and rescues builds brand awareness and community goodwill
Private label pet products provide 60-80% margins vs. 20-30% on branded resale
geodemand: Pet ownership correlates strongly with suburban populations and household size. tips: Segment Google Shopping campaigns by pet type (dog, cat, fish, reptile) — conversion rates vary 2-3x between species
Target breed-specific keywords for premium products. 'Large breed dog food' buyers spend 40% more than generic searchers
Run subscription-focused campaigns separately from one-time purchase campaigns — different LTV economics
Use customer match lists to target existing customers for cross-sell (dog owner → add cat products)
Seasonal campaigns for flea/tick season (spring) and holiday gifting (Nov-Dec) drive 40% of annual revenue

name: Electronics
subcats: Smartphones, Computers, Audio, Cameras, Smart Home, Gaming, Accessories

Spec-based search queries (RAM, storage, screen size) require structured product data in feeds
Refurbished and open-box listings need clear condition descriptions to avoid return rate spikes
Electronics have the highest return rates in ecommerce (15-25%) — factor this into ROAS calculations
Brand bidding restrictions from manufacturers limit Shopping ad options for authorized retailers
social: Unboxing and review video content drives consideration-stage engagement for electronics
Tech spec comparison content performs well as static carousel ads on Instagram and Facebook
Electronics purchase decisions involve 5-7 touchpoints — attribution across social and search is critical
Retargeting electronics browsers is essential — the research phase is 2-4 weeks for major purchases
Black Friday and Prime Day conditioning means consumers expect deals year-round
seo: Spec-based long-tail keywords ('best laptop for video editing 2026') capture high-intent comparison shoppers
Product review and comparison content is essential for E-E-A-T in electronics
Technical guides and how-to content builds topical authority and captures informational searches
Manufacturer model number searches indicate purchase-ready buyers — optimize product pages for these

landing: Comparison tables showing specs side-by-side reduce bounce rates by 30-40% on electronics pages
Financing options (Affirm, Klarna) on landing pages increase conversion 20-35% for items over $200
Expert review excerpts and ratings on product pages add social proof and reduce decision anxiety
Live inventory status and shipping estimates reduce cart abandonment for electronics purchases
Bundle suggestions (laptop + case + charger) increase AOV by 15-25%
smallbiz: Niche specialization (gaming peripherals, audio equipment, drone accessories) avoids Amazon price wars
Expert curation and hands-on testing differentiate small electronics retailers from mass market
Service and support (setup, repair, training) add revenue streams Amazon can't match
Refurbished and certified pre-owned markets offer higher margins and growing consumer interest
B2B electronics (office equipment, AV systems) has less price pressure than consumer markets
geodemand: Electronics demand is concentrated in tech hubs and high-income metros. San Francisco, Seattle, Austin, and Denver lead in per-capita electronics spending. tips: Segment campaigns by price tier — a $50 accessory and a $2,000 laptop need completely different bidding strategies

Run pre-order and launch day campaigns for new product releases — early adopters have the highest willingness to pay
Use customer lifetime value bidding — electronics buyers who purchase accessories have 3x the LTV of one-time buyers
Build seasonal campaigns around Black Friday, Prime Day, and back-to-school — these three windows drive 45% of annual electronics revenue
